name: 画外音测试
prompt_prefix: A cozy living room in polished 3D CG animation with warm indoor lighting. The camera stays locked off.
setting_line: The kitten girl sits at the table while an unseen voice speaks to her.

lines.speaker: 叙述者
lines.text: Before you were even in primary school.

lines.speaker: 小猫妹妹
lines.text: 我那时候还不认识字呢。

lines.speaker: 叙述者
lines.text: There were a few hedgehogs in the yard at home.

lines.speaker: 小猫妹妹
lines.text: 嗯，院子里是有几只小刺猬。

lines.speaker: 叙述者
lines.text: And then you walked over and stepped on them one by one.
